lore_anchors.definition: A defensive treasure inlaid with four rare pearls providing protection against wind, flame, water, and dust, while also calming the spirit. Its name borrows from the Four Symbols guardians of Chinese cosmology.

A forbidden human-ghost dual cultivation technique. The living cultivator forfeits reincarnation, the ghost becomes permanently anchored to the mortal plane. Progress is rapid in Netherworld-rich environments, but the penalties are structural and irreversible.

A Yin-aligned resurrection technique that attempts to call back a departed soul. In this story, it shatters the caster’s Golden Core if interrupted, leaving them stranded at a lower cultivation level.
A form of ambient energy found in the Netherworld Domain, suitable for ghost-path cultivation but generally hostile to living cultivators unaccustomed to Yin-type qi.
